part_A_translation_table_VW_to_engine.core_mathematical_judgement: KMSV Sec.4's lacunary expansion is about the DELTA-hauptmodul phi at the elliptic point z_a; VW's method is about GAMMA-forms at a point with TRIVIAL Gamma-stabiliser. These are different objects, not a conflict. The unique point that satisfies both is p = z_a = i: it is Delta-elliptic of order 3 but Gamma-REGULAR, because sigma_inf = lam3 has cycle type 3.3.3 (no fixed point) so no nontrivial power of delta_inf lies in Gamma. DECISION: build the linear system in the single disc coordinate w = (z-i)/(z+i), which is simultaneously VW's w(p;z) at p=i and KMSV Sec.4's disc coordinate at z_a. This choice was validated a posteriori (see part_D_unplanned_structural_confirmation).

rows.engine: three-stage composite: (i) ben2's greedy Delta-reduction toward the kite centroid returns h in Delta with h^{-1}z reduced and its permutation pi(h); (ii) coset lookup j := 1^{pi(h)}, set zred := g_j (h^{-1} z), gamma := h g_j^{-1}, which lies in Gamma by construction; (iii) Gamma-polish: greedily minimise |w(zred)| over a pool of 36 short Gamma elements (= Dirichlet reduction centred at p, exactly VW's D(p))

part_D_unplanned_structural_confirmation.finding: The echelon basis element f_1 at k=12 turns out to be LACUNARY in w^3: max|btilde_n| over n = 0 mod 3 is 5.7105e+00 while max|btilde_n| over n != 0 mod 3 is 4.2573e-18 (ratio 7.455e-19), at N = 90 over all 91 coefficients. The other basis element f_2 shows ratio 9.809e-01, i.e. no lacunarity at all -- the perfect internal control.
part_D_unplanned_structural_confirmation.explanation_derived_after_the_fact: Delta(7,2,3) has signature (0;7,2,3) and dim M_12(Delta) = 1 (machine-computed). The degree-9 action is PRIMITIVE (ben1 G1-c), so Gamma is a maximal subgroup and M_12(Delta) sits inside M_12(Gamma) as the unique line on which delta_inf acts trivially. A Delta-form of weight k expanded at an elliptic point of order e has b_n = 0 unless n = -k/2 (mod e); here e = 3, k = 12, so n = 0 (mod 3). Exactly what the machine produced.
part_D_unplanned_structural_confirmation.why_this_matters: Nothing about Delta-invariance, about M_12(Delta), or about elliptic-point lacunarity was put into the computation -- the linear system only ever saw Gamma. That the numerics spontaneously reproduce a 20-digit-clean lacunary series is strong independent evidence that (i) the reduction really returns Gamma elements, (ii) the automorphy factor convention is right, (iii) the choice p = z_a = i is the correct bridge between the Gamma side (VW) and the Delta side (KMSV Sec.4), since KMSV's phi is lacunary in exactly the same w^a.
